translation.title: Urea Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for progressive palmar keratoderma (the dry type of housewives' eczema), keratoderma of the palms and soles, ichthyosis, senile xerosis (age-related dry skin), keratosis pilaris (lichen pilaris), and atopic skin.
translation.usage: Wash the affected area, then apply this medicine once to several times a day and rub in thoroughly.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have acute eczema or an inflammatory skin condition, if you have renal failure, or on mucous membranes such as the eye mucosa. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have heightened sensitivity to inflammation, cracking (fissures), or skin irritation. This medicine is for external use only. Do not apply it directly to ulcers, erosions, or wounds. Take care to avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, and other mucous membranes; if it accidentally gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water. Pain and a warm sensation and, at times, flushing or itching may occur. Stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist if you develop hypersensitivity, or at times eczematization, skin cracking (fissures), papules, a prickling sensation, a burning sensation, scaling, or rarely swelling or dryness.
